sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Ballz Puzzle is a simple yet addictive game that requires players to launch balls at falling bricks. The game is set on a single screen, where bricks fall from the top and disappear when hit by a ball. The objective is to clear the screen before the bricks reach the bottom. Sounds easy, right? Wrong. As the game progresses, the bricks start to move faster, and the balls become harder to control. This is where the game's core mechanics come into play. Players need to time their ball-launches perfectly, taking into account the speed and trajectory of the brick, as well as the direction and speed of the ball.

The game also features a power-up system, where players can collect boosters to increase their score or unlock special abilities. These power-ups can be used strategically to clear the screen quickly or to overcome obstacles. The game also features a combo system, where players can earn points for consecutive ball-clearing combos. The longer the combo, the higher the points.

The game's controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy for players to pick up and play. Whether you're using a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, the game responds smoothly and accurately, allowing players to focus on the gameplay rather than the controls.

Overall, Ballz Puzzle's core gameplay mechanics are engaging, challenging, and addictive, making it a must-play for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers alike.
